tools.name: get_recent_scans
tools.description: List the most recent public scans, newest first (paginated with page and limit). Each row has the scan ID, URL, status, visibility and submission time. Unlisted and private scans are never included.

tools.name: submit_scan
tools.description: Submit a URL to ScanMalware to be rendered and analysed in an isolated analysis environment; returns the new scan_id. scan_type is required and sets who can see the result: 'public' lists the URL and its results in the public feed, visible to anyone and to search engines; 'unlisted' keeps the scan out of public listings, but anyone with its link can open it; 'private' limits the result to the ScanMalware account of this server's SCANMALWARE_BEARER_TOKEN and is rejected when no token is configured. Wraps POST /api/v1/scan of the ScanMalware API, documented at https://scanmalware.com/api-docs.

url.description: Full URL to scan, including http:// or https://. Private, loopback and internal addresses are refused.
url.title: Url

scan_type.description: Who can see the scan: public (listed in the public feed and search), unlisted (opens only with its link) or private (needs a ScanMalware account token on the server). Required; there is no default.
scan_type.title: Scan Type

options.description: Optional scanner options as a JSON object, passed to the ScanMalware API unchanged; omit for the defaults.
options.title: Options

user_agent.description: Optional User-Agent header to send with the submission request to the ScanMalware API.
user_agent.title: User Agent

tools.name: get_scan_summary
tools.description: Get a compact summary of one scan: submitted URL, final URL after redirects, status, completion time and the security verdict (verdict text, risk level, confidence and risk factors). Useful as the first look at a scan; the verdict is empty for a few seconds after a scan completes. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: wait_for_scan
tools.description: Wait for a submitted scan to finish by polling its status every poll_interval_s seconds, up to timeout_s seconds (default 180). Returns the final compact summary (URL, final URL, status, completion time and the security verdict), or the last known status with timeout set to true if the scan is still running. The security verdict is computed after the scan completes, usually within about a minute: until then verdict_pending is true and the verdict fields are empty, so a risk score of 0 is not yet a verdict. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

timeout_s.description: Total seconds to wait before returning, above 0 and at most 3600 (default 180).
timeout_s.title: Timeout S

tools.name: get_scan_result
tools.description: Get the result document of one scan: URLs and redirects, page title, load times, links, network requests, IP addresses, JavaScript files, TLS, fuzzy hashes, screenshot hashes, favicon and the security verdict. compact (default true) leaves out the raw network logs (HTTP transactions and their analysis, console logs, request and response lists) and the inline favicon image, most of a large result, and names what it left out in compacted; pass compact false for the full document. For a verdict alone, the scan summary is enough. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

compact.description: Leave out the raw network logs and the inline favicon image (default true); false returns the full document, which can run to several MB.
compact.title: Compact

tools.name: search_scans
tools.description: Search the archive of public scans by text in the URL, domain or page title (paginated); q needs at least 3 characters and search_type narrows the match (default 'all'). Each result has the scan ID, URL, status, title, submission time and hosting ASN.

q.description: Text to find in a scan's URL, domain or page title; at least 3 characters.
q.title: Q

search_type.description: Field to match: all (default), url, domain, title, technology or yara.
search_type.title: Search Type

tools.name: search_smql
tools.description: Search public scans with the ScanMalware Query Language (SMQL): field filters such as domain:paypal.com, ip:1.2.3.4, favicon_hash:<mmh3>, js_sha256:<hash>, jarm:<fingerprint> or title:login, combined with AND, OR, NOT, a leading - and parentheses; ranges such as submitted:last7d or js_risk_score:60..100; existence checks such as has:malware. Defanged indicators (paypal[.]com) are accepted. Paginated (page up to 1000, limit up to 100); sort is newest, oldest, url, load_time or ip_count; count_only returns only the number of matches. An unknown filter is rejected with a suggested correction. Broad wildcard queries can take tens of seconds.

q.description: SMQL query, for example domain:paypal.com AND title:login; up to 2000 characters.
q.title: Q

sort.description: Result order: newest (default), oldest, url, load_time or ip_count.
sort.title: Sort

count_only.description: Return only the number of matching scans, without results; faster when only the count is needed.
count_only.title: Count Only

tools.name: get_smql_facets
tools.description: Summarise what the scans matching an SMQL query have in common: the most frequent hosting networks, countries, domains, registrars, certificate issuers, technologies, favicons, JARM fingerprints, tracking IDs and AI verdicts. Counts cover the newest sample matching scans (100 to 5000, default 1000), not every match. Each value carries a ready SMQL filter to AND onto the query. fields is a comma-separated list of primary_asn, primary_ip, country, domain, title, registrar, nameserver, cert_issuer, technology, favicon_hash, phash, jarm, ja4s, tracking_id and verdict (a default set when omitted); size is values per facet (1 to 25).

q.description: SMQL query whose matching scans to summarise, for example title:"verify your account".
q.title: Q

fields.description: Comma-separated facet names, for example primary_asn,country,registrar; omit for the default set.
fields.title: Fields

size.description: Values to return per facet, 1 to 25.
size.title: Size

sample.description: How many of the newest matching scans to aggregate, 100 to 5000.
sample.title: Sample

tools.name: search_smql_domains
tools.description: Search domains rather than scans with SMQL domain filters, including domains ScanMalware never scanned, each with its newest public scan when one exists. Filters: ct_ip:<ip or /24> (domains on an address when their certificates were issued), nameserver:<exact host> (registered domains delegated to it, optionally AND tld:se), ct_domain:/ct_san: (certificate hostnames, wildcards allowed; add AND ct_issued:last7d to make a wildcard much faster) and tld:. A wildcard over every certificate log runs for a minute or more: the answer then has status 'running', and repeating the same query later returns the result. Paginated by limit (1 to 500) and next_cursor.

q.description: SMQL query with domain filters (ct_ip:, nameserver:, ct_domain:, ct_san:, tld:), for example ct_ip:192.0.2.10.
q.title: Q

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_smql_filters
tools.description: Describe the SMQL query language. Without category: the syntax, the has: existence checks and the filter names in each category (Core, Network, WHOIS, Security, Content, TLS, JARM, Technology, JavaScript, Hashes, Files, Hosts, WebAssembly, Deobfuscation, Tracking, Contacts, DNS, CT). With category: every filter in it with its type, description, examples and whether it supports wildcards, ranges or comparisons.

category.description: Filter category to describe in full, for example DNS, Hashes or JavaScript; omit for an index of every filter name.
category.title: Category

tools.name: count_smql_queries
tools.description: Count the public scans matching each of up to 25 SMQL queries in one request, for example to see which indicators of a campaign are selective. Each count stops at 10,000 (exact_count is then false); a count that ran out of time has count_unavailable true, and a query that does not parse gets its own error without failing the others. With sites true, queries with 10 or more matches also get the number of distinct sites, how many of them are rated high risk, and whether the value is shared widely by unrelated sites. Counts are cached for up to 30 minutes.

queries.description: SMQL queries to count, 1 to 25, each up to 2000 characters.
queries.title: Queries

sites.description: Also summarise the sites behind each query with 10 or more matches: distinct sites, how many are rated high risk, and whether the value is shared widely by unrelated sites.
sites.title: Sites

tools.name: get_scan_pivot_values
tools.description: List the searchable values of one scan beyond its main result: SHA-256 of every response body it loaded, its scripts with their structure and content hashes, script hosts, hosts named in script source, tracking IDs, IDS signatures and more, each with the SMQL filter that finds other scans sharing it. Useful for pivoting from a known phishing page to related ones. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_scan_graph
tools.description: Compare up to 20 public scans side by side: each with URL, final URL, host, title, AI verdict and risk score, rule-based risk, screenshot URL, and the values that link it to other scans (domains, IP addresses, hashes, technologies, certificate, JARM, registration, CPE and threat-intelligence matches). missing lists IDs that are not public scans. The per-scan searchable-value lists (typically 50 to 150 KB per scan) are left out unless include_pivot_values is true; favicon images are always left out.

scan_ids.description: UUIDs of 1 to 20 public scans to compare; duplicates are ignored.
scan_ids.title: Scan Ids

include_pivot_values.description: Also include each scan's full list of searchable values (often 50 to 150 KB per scan).
include_pivot_values.title: Include Pivot Values

tools.name: get_ai_analysis
tools.description: Get the AI analysis of one scan: classification (LEGITIMATE to CONFIRMED_SCAM), scam type, risk score, confidence, impersonated brand and the key evidence behind it. The analysis is produced a few minutes after the scan completes and returns not found until then. It can disagree with the scanner's own security verdict. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_scan_progress
tools.description: Get the progress of a running scan: current step, total steps, step name, percentage and status. Useful for checking whether a scan has finished before reading its results. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_scan_ioc
tools.description: Check one scan against threat-intelligence indicator feeds: matching IP addresses and domains the page contacted, the threat types, and a summary of total and unique matches. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_tls_details
tools.description: Get the TLS certificate the scanned site presented: subject, issuer, validity dates, whether it was valid or expired, and related details. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_tls_asn1
tools.description: Get the raw ASN.1 structure of the TLS certificate from one scan, for detailed certificate inspection. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_technologies_by_scan
tools.description: List the web technologies detected on a scanned page (frameworks, CMS, CDN, analytics and so on), with versions where known. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_bot_protection
tools.description: Get the bot-protection and CAPTCHA services detected on a scanned page (for example Cloudflare Turnstile), with a detected flag. Phishing kits often use these to hide from scanners. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_yara_matches
tools.description: Get the YARA rule matches recorded for one scan, with the matching rules and a summary by severity and category. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_jarm_signatures
tools.description: Get the JARM TLS server fingerprints measured for the hosts in one scan, with whether each matches a known signature. A shared JARM often points to the same server software or hosting platform, so it is a weak pivot on its own. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_analyzer_results
tools.description: List which analysis modules ran for one scan (for example JavaScript fingerprinting and AI analysis), with each module's status, success flag and timing. Useful for checking why a result is missing. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_clipboard_events
tools.description: Get the clipboard writes the page attempted while it was scanned, with the event count and whether collection ran. Empty with an explanatory note when the page wrote nothing. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_js_fingerprints
tools.description: List the JavaScript files a scanned page loaded, each with its fingerprint: hashes (SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5, normalized and fuzzy), size metrics, detected library and bundler. The include_* options add function lists, HTTP headers or ML vector details. Paginated with limit (default 20) and offset: total_scripts is the scan's number of scripts and fingerprints_count the number returned. Useful for collecting script hashes to search for elsewhere. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

include_functions.description: Include the list of functions extracted from each script.
include_functions.title: Include Functions

include_http_headers.description: Include the HTTP response headers each script was served with.
include_http_headers.title: Include Http Headers

include_vectors_info.description: Include whether machine-learning similarity vectors exist for each script.
include_vectors_info.title: Include Vectors Info

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: get_scan_reports
tools.description: Count the votes users cast on one scan: thumbs up (marked safe), thumbs down (marked malicious) and the total. All zero when nobody has voted. The individual reports are not public. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_domain_scans
tools.description: List the recent scans of a domain and its subdomains, newest first, up to limit; status filters by scan status. Each row has matched_on: 'url' when the scan was submitted for a host under this domain, and only 'final_url' when another site redirected there. A verdict on a final_url-only row belongs to the submitted host, not to this domain.

domain.description: Domain name such as example.com, or an IP address.
domain.title: Domain

status.description: Only scans with this status: queued, processing, completed or failed; omit for all.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_domain_history
tools.description: Get the scan history of a domain with the total count and the scans, paginated with page and limit.

domain.description: Domain name such as example.com, or an IP address.
domain.title: Domain

tools.name: get_domain_stats
tools.description: Get scan counts for a domain: total, unique, completed and failed scans, first and latest scan, and scans in the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days.

domain.description: Domain name such as example.com, or an IP address.
domain.title: Domain

tools.name: search_by_ip
tools.description: List scans of pages served from an IP address (paginated), each with scan ID, URL and time. On shared hosting and CDNs an IP serves many unrelated sites, so a match is not evidence of a connection.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address the scanned pages were served from.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

tools.name: get_ip_stats
tools.description: Get statistics for an IP address across the archive: total scans, unique URLs, first and last seen, geolocation, ASN and organisation, BGP and DNS data; paginated.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to report on.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

tools.name: search_by_asn
tools.description: Get what the archive knows about an autonomous system (ASN number, without 'AS'): organisation, total scans, unique URLs, first and last seen and BGP prefixes; paginated.

asn_number.description: Autonomous system number without the AS prefix, for example 13335.
asn_number.title: Asn Number

tools.name: search_similar_scans
tools.description: Find scans that look like this one by screenshot similarity, favicon or fuzzy page hash (methods, default screenshot), each with URL, final URL, title and what it matched by; paginated. Useful for finding copies of a phishing page on other hosts. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

methods.description: Similarity methods to use: screenshot (default), favicon and fuzzy (page content hash).
methods.title: Methods

tools.name: search_semantic
tools.description: Search scans by meaning, comparing text with screenshot embeddings (for example 'bank login page asking for card details'). threshold defaults to -0.2 on a -1 to 1 scale; text-to-image scores are usually around -0.4 to 0.1, so useful thresholds are around -0.3 to 0. An empty result means nothing met the chosen threshold.

query.description: Plain-language description of the page to find, for example 'bank login page asking for card details'.
query.title: Query

threshold.description: Minimum similarity, -1 to 1 (default -0.2); text-to-screenshot scores usually fall between -0.4 and 0.1.
threshold.title: Threshold

tools.name: search_by_favicon
tools.description: Search scans by favicon hash (paginated): a mmh3 hash by default, or the favicon's MD5 with hash_type='md5'.

hash_value.description: Favicon hash to find: an mmh3 hash (a signed integer, as in Shodan's http.favicon.hash), or the favicon's MD5 when hash_type is md5.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

hash_type.description: Kind of hash in hash_value: mmh3 (default) or md5.
hash_type.title: Hash Type

tools.name: search_ai_high_risk
tools.description: List scans that the AI analysis rated high risk, optionally above min_risk_score and min_confidence, each with URL, title and the analysis. min_risk_score is on the AI's 0-10 risk scale (default 7) and min_confidence is a 0-100 percentage (default 70).

min_confidence.description: Minimum AI confidence, as a percentage from 0 to 100.
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

tools.name: search_ai_scam_type
tools.description: List scans whose AI analysis named a given scam type, such as 'Phishing', each with URL, title, submission time and the analysis (verdict, classification, risk score). The match is on the scam type text the analysis produced.

scam_type.description: Scam type as the AI analysis names it, for example Phishing.
scam_type.title: Scam Type

tools.name: search_ai_classification
tools.description: List scans whose AI analysis gave a specific classification: LEGITIMATE, LOW_RISK, MODERATE_RISK, HIGH_RISK or CONFIRMED_SCAM. Each result has the URL, title, submission time and the analysis.

classification.description: AI classification to list: LEGITIMATE, LOW_RISK, MODERATE_RISK, HIGH_RISK or CONFIRMED_SCAM.
classification.title: Classification

tools.name: get_analyzer_stats
tools.description: Get platform-wide statistics for the scan analysis modules: the modules and their run counts. Describes the service, not a particular scan.

tools.name: search_analyzer_high_risk
tools.description: List scans that the security analyzer scored as high risk, highest first (paginated), each with URL, risk score, verdict, confidence and analysis time. min_risk_score raises the threshold.

tools.name: get_favicon
tools.description: Get the favicon recorded for a scan_id: the original icon's MD5 and mmh3 hashes, the ones favicon search indexes, and the stored copy's size, SHA-256 and image, base64-encoded. found is false when no favicon is stored for the scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_favicon_stats
tools.description: Get favicon statistics across the archive: total favicons, those seen in the last 24 hours and the most common hashes with sample URLs. This aggregate query can take up to 90 seconds by default.

tools.name: get_screenshot_stats
tools.description: Get screenshot statistics across the archive: total screenshots, hash coverage and the distribution of perceptual hash types.

tools.name: search_similar_screenshots
tools.description: Find screenshots within max_distance (Hamming distance, default 3) of an integer perceptual hash (hash_type, default phash), each with scan, URL, title, distance and similarity score.

hash_value.description: Perceptual hash of a screenshot, as an integer.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

hash_type.description: Kind of perceptual hash: phash (default), ahash, dhash or whash.
hash_type.title: Hash Type

max_distance.description: Largest Hamming distance that still counts as similar, 1 to 10 (default 3).
max_distance.title: Max Distance

tools.name: search_ocr
tools.description: Search OCR text (paginated). q must contain at least 3 characters after trimming. This query can take up to 90 seconds by default.

q.description: Text to find in the OCR text of scan screenshots; at least 3 characters.
q.title: Q

tools.name: search_ocr_pattern
tools.description: Search the text read by OCR from scan screenshots for a pattern (paginated); case_sensitive controls matching. Useful for finding pages that show the same lure text as an image.

pattern.description: Text to find in the OCR text of scan screenshots; at least 3 letters or digits.
pattern.title: Pattern

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly (default false).
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

tools.name: search_by_jarm
tools.description: List scans whose server presented this JARM TLS fingerprint (paginated). Large hosting platforms share JARMs across many unrelated sites, so check what the matches have in common.

jarm_signature.description: JARM TLS fingerprint, a 62-character hex string.
jarm_signature.title: Jarm Signature

tools.name: search_by_fuzzy_hash
tools.description: List scans whose page content has a similar fuzzy hash (hash_type tlsh, ssdeep or sdhash; the value comes from a scan result), each with URL, title and time; paginated. Useful for finding near-identical copies of a page.

hash_type.description: Kind of fuzzy hash in hash_value: tlsh, ssdeep or sdhash.
hash_type.title: Hash Type

hash_value.description: Fuzzy hash of a page's content, as shown in a scan result.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

tools.name: search_by_screenshot_hash
tools.description: List scans whose screenshot has this perceptual hash (hash_type ahash, phash, dhash, whash, color_hash or crop_resistant), optionally within similarity_threshold, each with URL, title and time; paginated. Useful for finding pages that look the same.

hash_type.description: Kind of screenshot hash: ahash, phash, dhash, whash, color_hash or crop_resistant.
hash_type.title: Hash Type

hash_value.description: Screenshot hash to find, any case: 16 hex characters for ahash, phash, dhash and whash, or 11 hex digits for color_hash.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

similarity_threshold.description: Largest Hamming distance for a similar match (ahash, phash, dhash and whash only); omit for exact matches.
similarity_threshold.title: Similarity Threshold

tools.name: search_suspicious_clipboard
tools.description: List scans where the page wrote suspicious content to the clipboard (for example PowerShell commands), each with URL, event count, reason and time; pattern filters the content; paginated.

pattern.description: Text to look for in the suspicious clipboard content, for example powershell; omit for all.
pattern.title: Pattern

tools.name: get_recent_threats
tools.description: List malware threats detected in scans during the last hours (default window set by the API), with totals and grouping by threat.

hours.description: How many hours to look back; omit for the API's default window.
hours.title: Hours

tools.name: get_recent_yara_threats
tools.description: List YARA rule matches from scans in the last hours (1 to 168, default 24), each with the scan, URL, rule, category, severity and confidence.

hours.description: How many hours to look back, 1 to 168 (default 24).
hours.title: Hours

tools.name: get_ct_certificates
tools.description: Get the certificates issued for a domain according to Certificate Transparency logs, with a found flag.

tools.name: get_ct_dns_records
tools.description: List subdomains of a domain found through Certificate Transparency, with their DNS records (type, IP addresses, TTL) and when they were seen. Useful for finding the other hosts of a domain.

tools.name: get_ct_domains_by_ip
tools.description: List domains that Certificate Transparency and DNS data associate with an IP address, with record counts and the total.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

tools.name: get_ct_root_domains_by_ip
tools.description: List the registrable domains that resolved to an IP address when their TLS certificates were issued, alphabetical, each with the hostnames seen under it, the number of resolution records and when they were first and last seen. A domain that moved to the address after its certificate was issued is not listed. window is recent, standard (default) or extended; paginated by limit (1 to 500) and next_cursor. Can be briefly unavailable under load (HTTP 503); retry after a pause.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address the domains resolved to.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

window.description: How far back to list: recent, standard (default) or extended.
window.title: Window

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_dns_history
tools.description: Get every DNS answer a name has given, newest first: the records seen when public pages using it were scanned and the addresses it resolved to when TLS certificates for it were published, each with first and last seen. For a domain this includes its _dmarc record and a wildcard probe; for an IP address, its reverse-DNS (PTR) names. DNS lookups during scans started on 28 October 2026. name is a hostname, domain or IP address; limit is 1 to 500.

name.description: Hostname, domain or IP address whose DNS answers to list, for example login.example.com.
name.title: Name

tools.name: search_reverse_dns
tools.description: Find the names whose DNS pointed at a value during public scans. kind ip: names that resolved to an address or into a network (CIDR up to /16 for IPv4, /32 for IPv6), plus the address's reverse-DNS names. kind mx, ns, cname or ptr: names whose records point at that host. kind spf_include: domains whose SPF includes it. kind soa: primary nameserver or contact mailbox. kind verification: a site-verification key=token TXT value. Useful for finding other domains run by the same operator. limit is 1 to 500.

kind.description: What value is: ip (an address or CIDR network), mx, ns, cname or ptr (a hostname), spf_include (an SPF include domain), soa (a primary nameserver or contact mailbox) or verification (a key=token TXT value).
kind.title: Kind

value.description: Address, network, hostname or token to look up, matching kind; for example 192.0.2.0/24 or ns1.example.net.
value.title: Value

tools.name: get_scan_dns
tools.description: Get the DNS answers recorded for one scan when it ran: the scanned hostnames, the registrable domain's mail servers, nameservers, TXT, SOA, CAA, _dmarc and wildcard records, reverse-DNS names of its addresses and, on a sample of scans, the addresses of third-party hosts the page contacted, with a summary of the mail, SPF, DMARC and wildcard setup. recorded is false for scans before 28 October 2026 or whose lookup has not finished. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_domain_hosts
tools.description: List every host seen for a domain (or IP address) across its newest scans, grouped by evidence: observed (the browser requested it) and scripts (a script the browser loaded) by default; declared (named in Content-Security-Policy, intent only), static (a URL in script source) and referenced (only a string or comment) on request in sources. subdomains_only keeps hosts below the domain. max_scans (1 to 1000, default 200) is how many scans to aggregate; limit (1 to 10000, default 500) caps hosts per source.

domain.description: Domain name such as example.com, or an IP address.
domain.title: Domain

sources.description: Evidence kinds to include: observed and scripts by default; add declared (Content-Security-Policy), static (URLs in script source) or referenced (strings and comments only).
sources.title: Sources

subdomains_only.description: Return only hosts strictly below the domain.
subdomains_only.title: Subdomains Only

max_scans.description: How many of the domain's newest scans to aggregate, 1 to 1000 (default 200).
max_scans.title: Max Scans

limit.description: Maximum hosts per evidence kind, 1 to 10000 (default 500).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_ct_similar_domains
tools.description: Find domains with names similar to a domain in Certificate Transparency data (for example lookalikes and typosquats), each with a certificate count and the kind of similarity.

tools.name: get_ct_timeline
tools.description: Get the certificate history of a domain from Certificate Transparency: when certificates were issued and when the certificate changed.

tools.name: get_api_root
tools.description: Get the ScanMalware API's name, version, status, main endpoints and feature list.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Check whether the ScanMalware API is up. Returns the service status.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Get the current scan queue length, running scans and scans completed in the last 24 hours by visibility.

tools.name: get_latest_capabilities
tools.description: Get the current size of ScanMalware's detection content: indicator count, malware detection rules and ClamAV signatures.

tools.name: get_capabilities_by_date
tools.description: Get the size of ScanMalware's detection content (indicators, detection rules, ClamAV signatures) on a given date (scan_date, YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_clipboard_stats
tools.description: Get clipboard and pastejacking statistics across the archive: event totals, detections and daily activity.

tools.name: get_cpe_stats
tools.description: Get CPE statistics across the archive: scans with CPEs, unique CPEs, total detections, top vendors and products.

tools.name: get_cpe_by_scan
tools.description: List the CPE identifiers (product and version names in the NVD format) derived from the technologies detected on a scanned page, with their source. Useful for matching against vulnerability data. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: search_cpe
tools.description: Find scans with a CPE identifier matching a pattern such as 'cpe:2.3:a:facebook:react' (paginated). Useful for finding sites running a given product.

cpe_pattern.description: CPE identifier or prefix to match, for example cpe:2.3:a:jquery:jquery.
cpe_pattern.title: Cpe Pattern

tools.name: get_ids_alerts
tools.description: Get intrusion detection (IDS) alerts raised on the network traffic recorded during one scan, with a severity breakdown and total count. Empty when no rule fired. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_jarm_stats
tools.description: Get JARM statistics across the archive, including the most common signatures. Common signatures usually belong to large hosting platforms.

tools.name: get_malware_stats
tools.description: Get malware detection statistics across the archive: overall and last-24-hour counts, top threats and hourly trend.

tools.name: get_malware_by_scan
tools.description: Get the malware detections for files the scanned page delivered, with threat names, detection counts and the detection source. Empty when nothing was detected. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_yara_stats
tools.description: Get YARA statistics across the archive: overall and last-24-hour matches, severity and category distribution and top threats.

tools.name: get_yara_by_scan
tools.description: Get YARA rule matches for one scan, with a summary by severity (critical, high, medium, low) and category. Empty when no rule matched. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_safe_browsing_stats
tools.description: Get Google Safe Browsing statistics across the archive: total threats, threats in the last 7 days, scans with threats and threat types.

tools.name: get_safe_browsing
tools.description: Get Google Safe Browsing threats found for the URLs in one scan, with a has_threats flag. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_top_tracking_keys
tools.description: List the tracking and site keys seen on the most sites (analytics IDs, CAPTCHA keys and so on), with the tracker name, category and site count; tracker_type filters by kind.

tracker_type.description: Only this tracker type, for example google_analytics; omit for all.
tracker_type.title: Tracker Type

tools.name: search_tracking_key
tools.description: Find scans that embed a given tracking or site key, such as an analytics ID or a CAPTCHA site key (tracker_type and key), sorted latest or oldest; paginated. A shared key often ties sites to one operator.

tracker_type.description: Tracker type of the key, for example google_analytics or facebook_pixel.
tracker_type.title: Tracker Type

key.description: The tracking or site key itself, for example an analytics ID or a CAPTCHA site key.
key.title: Key

sort.description: Result order: latest or oldest; omit for the API's default.
sort.title: Sort

tools.name: search_technologies
tools.description: Search the web technologies detected across the archive by name (q) or category, each with how many scans used it and when it was last seen; paginated.

q.description: Technology name to search for; partial names match.
q.title: Q

category.description: Only technologies in this category, for example CMS or Analytics.
category.title: Category

tools.name: get_technology_combinations
tools.description: List the technologies most often detected together with a given technology, with counts; min_occurrences drops rare pairs; paginated.

tech_name.description: Technology to find combinations for, for example WordPress.
tech_name.title: Tech Name

min_occurrences.description: Leave out combinations seen fewer times than this.
min_occurrences.title: Min Occurrences

tools.name: get_popular_technologies
tools.description: List the most frequently detected web technologies over the last days (paginated).

days.description: How many days to look back; omit for the API's default.
days.title: Days

tools.name: get_technology_stats
tools.description: Get technology detection statistics across the archive: unique technologies, total detections and counts per category. This aggregate query can take up to 90 seconds by default.

tools.name: search_by_nameserver
tools.description: List the scanned domains that use a given nameserver, with totals and counts per top-level domain. Useful for finding domains registered together.

tools.name: get_rdap
tools.description: Get registration data (RDAP) for the scanned domain and its IP addresses: registrar, registration and expiry dates, domain age, nameservers and status. A very young domain is a common phishing signal. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: search_by_registrar
tools.description: List scans of domains registered through a given registrar (paginated), with the total. Common registrars match very many domains.

registrar_name.description: Registrar name as registration data reports it, for example GoDaddy.com, LLC.
registrar_name.title: Registrar Name

tools.name: submit_scan_report
tools.description: Vote on a scan, as the Mark as Safe and Mark as Malicious buttons on its result page do: report_type 'positive_feedback' marks the scanned page as safe and 'malware' marks it as malicious. report_details is an optional note of up to 1000 characters. Votes are recorded as crowd feedback on the scan and are rate-limited per client IP. The website's other report types (phishing, spam, copyright and so on) need a captcha and are not available here.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

report_type.description: Vote to cast: positive_feedback (mark as safe) or malware (mark as malicious).
report_type.title: Report Type

report_details.description: Optional note explaining the vote, at most 1000 characters.
report_details.title: Report Details

tools.name: get_ocr_stats
tools.description: Get OCR statistics across the archive: scans with OCR text, average confidence and length, language distribution and daily counts.

tools.name: get_ocr_by_scan
tools.description: Get the text read by OCR from the scan's screenshot, with language, confidence, word and character counts and any regions flagged as suspicious. Useful when page text is drawn as images. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_open_graph
tools.description: Get the Open Graph and Twitter card metadata the scanned page declared (title, description, image, site name). Phishing pages often copy a brand's metadata. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_pastejacking
tools.description: Get pastejacking findings for one scan: attempts by the page to replace what a visitor copies, a common trick for making victims paste malicious commands. Includes a detected flag and a note. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_netlog
tools.description: Describe the network log (Chrome NetLog) for a scan_id: whether one exists, its size, and its encoding. The log itself is not returned - these are routinely tens of megabytes gzipped.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_pcap_metadata
tools.description: Describe the packet capture (PCAP) recorded during one scan: whether it exists, its size, compression and content type. The capture itself is not returned. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: search_favicon_mmh3
tools.description: List scans whose favicon has this mmh3 hash (the same convention as Shodan's http.favicon.hash), each with the page URL, title and favicon details; paginated. Phishing kits often reuse one favicon across many hosts.

mmh3_hash.description: Favicon mmh3 hash as a signed integer, as in Shodan's http.favicon.hash.
mmh3_hash.title: Mmh3 Hash

tools.name: get_js_runtime_behaviour
tools.description: Get the runtime JavaScript behaviour recorded for one scan: overall risk, risk scores, number of scripts, eval and Function-constructor calls and high-risk events, with a behavioural signature and composite hash. include_detailed_events adds the individual events. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

include_detailed_events.description: Include every recorded event; this can be very large (10 MB or more).
include_detailed_events.title: Include Detailed Events

tools.name: get_js_runtime_stats
tools.description: Get platform-wide statistics for runtime JavaScript analysis: risk distribution, averages and totals of eval calls and high-risk events. Describes the service, not a scan.

tools.name: get_js_runtime_health
tools.description: Check whether the runtime JavaScript analysis service is up, with its version.

tools.name: get_js_runtime_coverage
tools.description: Get how many scans have runtime JavaScript fingerprints: coverage percentage and the number of unique composite hashes and signatures. Describes the service, not a scan.

tools.name: search_js_obfuscation
tools.description: List scans by the obfuscation signals their runtime JavaScript showed, newest analysis first: overall risk, maximum and average risk score, eval and Function constructor calls and high-risk events. Optional filters are risk_level (such as 'high' or 'critical'), min_risk_score (0-100) and has_eval; with none, the most recently analysed scans are listed.

risk_level.description: Only this overall risk level: low, medium, high or critical.
risk_level.title: Risk Level

has_eval.description: true for only scans whose scripts called eval(), false for only scans whose scripts did not.
has_eval.title: Has Eval

tools.name: search_js_malware_families
tools.description: List groups of scans whose runtime JavaScript behaves alike (possible malware families), with clusters of at least min_cluster_size scans (default 2) at similarity_threshold or above (0 to 1, default 0.95). When the service has clustering switched off, status is 'disabled' and no families are returned.

min_cluster_size.description: Minimum number of scans in a family.
min_cluster_size.title: Min Cluster Size

similarity_threshold.description: How alike scans must behave to share a family, 0 to 1.
similarity_threshold.title: Similarity Threshold

tools.name: search_js_runtime_by_composite_hash
tools.description: Find scans whose runtime JavaScript behaviour has this composite hash, each with the target URL, overall risk and time. The same composite hash across hosts usually means the same kit.

composite_hash.description: SHA-256 composite hash of a scan's runtime behaviour fingerprint.
composite_hash.title: Composite Hash

tools.name: search_js_runtime_by_signature
tools.description: Find scans with this behavioural signature (for example 'setTimeout:30|fetch:4|complex'), each with the target URL, overall risk and time. An uncached query can take up to 90 seconds by default.

tools.name: search_js_runtime_similar
tools.description: Find scans whose runtime JavaScript behaviour is similar to this scan's, above min_similarity; include_self keeps the scan itself. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

include_self.description: Also list the scan the comparison starts from.
include_self.title: Include Self

tools.name: get_js_segments_by_scan
tools.description: List the code segments (functions and blocks) extracted from one scan's JavaScript, each with location, length, snippet and hashes; script_url narrows to one file, paginated with limit and offset. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

script_url.description: Only segments from this script URL.
script_url.title: Script Url

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for the API's default.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: search_js_segments_by_hash
tools.description: Find code segments with this exact code hash across the archive, with the scans and scripts they appear in; paginated with limit and offset.

code_hash.description: SHA-256 code hash of a code segment.
code_hash.title: Code Hash

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for the API's default.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: search_js_segments_by_normalized_hash
tools.description: Find code segments with this normalized hash (formatting-independent) across the archive, with the scans and scripts they appear in; paginated with limit and offset. variant_count is how many code variants share the hash; above 200 only the newest 200 are searched, total_count_capped is true and total_count is a lower bound.

normalized_hash.description: Normalized code hash of a code segment (computed with whitespace removed).
normalized_hash.title: Normalized Hash

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for the API's default.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: get_js_segments_suspicious
tools.description: List the JavaScript code segments from one scan scored as suspicious, above min_risk_score, with location, snippet and risk details; paginated with limit and offset. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for the API's default.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: get_js_segments_unknown
tools.description: List the JavaScript code segments from one scan that match no known library, at least min_code_length long; these are usually the page's own or a kit's code. Paginated with limit and offset. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for the API's default.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: run_js_differential_analysis
tools.description: Compare the JavaScript of one scan against known libraries and report which code segments match a library, which are unknown and which look suspicious, with a per-library breakdown. Matches below min_confidence (default 0.8) are not counted; known library code is excluded unless include_known_libraries is true. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence, 0 to 1, for a segment to count as a known library (default 0.8).
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

include_known_libraries.description: Also list the segments that matched known libraries.
include_known_libraries.title: Include Known Libraries

tools.name: get_js_library_inventory
tools.description: List the JavaScript libraries and versions detected across the archive, with how many scans used each; library filters to one library and min_count drops rare versions. Identifiers are lowercase names such as 'react', 'jquery' or 'nextjs'.

library.description: Only this library, for example jquery.
library.title: Library

min_count.description: Leave out libraries with fewer fingerprints than this.
min_count.title: Min Count

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_patterns
tools.description: List scanned JavaScript files that match code-pattern filters: has_eval, has_crypto, high_entropy, no_library and cdn_mismatch, where false selects files without the pattern and filters can be combined. With no filter given, has_eval=true is applied. Each result has the fingerprint ID, scan, script URL, code length, obfuscation score and the patterns detected.

high_entropy.description: Scripts rated moderately obfuscated or more.
high_entropy.title: High Entropy

no_library.description: Scripts not identified as a known library.
no_library.title: No Library

cdn_mismatch.description: Scripts served from a CDN URL but not identified as a known library.
cdn_mismatch.title: Cdn Mismatch

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_obfuscated
tools.description: List scanned JavaScript scored as obfuscated, filtered by score range, classification and minimum code length; exclude_libraries drops known library code. min_score and max_score are obfuscation scores from 0 to 1 (defaults 0.7 and 1.0). Paginated with page and per_page.

classification.description: Only this obfuscation classification, as the API names it.
classification.title: Classification

exclude_libraries.description: Leave out scripts identified as known libraries.
exclude_libraries.title: Exclude Libraries

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_server
tools.description: Find JavaScript by the type of web server that served it (for example 'nginx' or 'microsoft'), with the matching scripts; include_headers adds the HTTP headers. The total can be a lower bound.

server_type.description: Web server type, for example nginx, apache or microsoft.
server_type.title: Server Type

include_headers.description: Include the HTTP response headers of each script.
include_headers.title: Include Headers

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_bundler
tools.description: Find JavaScript bundles built with a given bundler (webpack, vite, rollup, esbuild and so on), optionally by bundle format and detection confidence, with totals, format breakdown and average size; paginated with page and per_page.

bundler_type.description: Bundler, for example webpack, vite, rollup or esbuild.
bundler_type.title: Bundler Type

bundle_format.description: Only bundles in this module format, for example esm or iife.
bundle_format.title: Bundle Format

include_libraries.description: Include the libraries found inside each bundle.
include_libraries.title: Include Libraries

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_cdn
tools.description: Find JavaScript served from a given CDN (for example 'cloudflare' or 'jsdelivr'), with totals, the top serving domains and cache status; unpinned_only keeps scripts loaded without a fixed version.

cdn_type.description: CDN, for example cloudflare, jsdelivr or unpkg.
cdn_type.title: Cdn Type

cdn_cache_status.description: Only responses with this CDN cache status, for example HIT or MISS.
cdn_cache_status.title: Cdn Cache Status

unpinned_only.description: Only scripts loaded without a pinned version.
unpinned_only.title: Unpinned Only

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_library
tools.description: Find scanned JavaScript detected as a given library (for example 'react', 'jquery' or 'nextjs'; 'Next.js' is accepted for 'nextjs'), optionally one version or a version pattern, with a version breakdown and CDN distribution; paginated with page and per_page.

library_name.description: Library name, for example react, jquery or nextjs ('Next.js' is also accepted).
library_name.title: Library Name

version.description: Only this exact version, for example 3.7.1.
version.title: Version

version_pattern.description: Only versions matching this pattern, for example 3.*.
version_pattern.title: Version Pattern

include_cdn_only.description: Include scripts identified only by their CDN URL.
include_cdn_only.title: Include Cdn Only

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_library_version
tools.description: Find scanned JavaScript detected as one exact library version, with the total and the matching scripts; include_deprecated and group_by_url adjust the results. Useful for finding sites running a vulnerable version.

library.description: Library name as detected, for example jquery, react or nextjs.
library.title: Library

group_by_url.description: Group the matching scripts by URL.
group_by_url.title: Group By Url

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_fuzzy_hash
tools.description: Find JavaScript files whose fuzzy hash is close to this one, above min_similarity, up to limit results. Fuzzy hashes match files that differ in small parts, such as a kit with a changed configuration.

fuzzy_hash.description: Fuzzy hash of a JavaScript file, as shown in its fingerprint.
fuzzy_hash.title: Fuzzy Hash

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_md5
tools.description: Look up a JavaScript file by MD5 across the archive and report its prevalence: total matches, unique scans, first and last seen, a prevalence label and the matching scripts; include_scans adds the scans, from_date and to_date limit the period.

hash_value.description: MD5 of a JavaScript file's content (32 hex characters).
hash_value.title: Hash Value

include_scans.description: Also list the scans in which the file appeared.
include_scans.title: Include Scans

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_normalized_hash
tools.description: Look up JavaScript by normalized hash (computed after whitespace and formatting are removed, so reformatted copies still match) and report prevalence: total matches, unique scans, first and last seen and the matching scripts.

hash_value.description: Normalized hash of a JavaScript file: its hash after whitespace and formatting are removed.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

include_scans.description: Also list the scans in which the file appeared.
include_scans.title: Include Scans

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_sha1
tools.description: Look up a JavaScript file by SHA-1 across the archive and report its prevalence: total matches, unique scans, first and last seen, a prevalence label and the matching scripts; include_scans adds the scans, from_date and to_date limit the period.

hash_value.description: SHA-1 of a JavaScript file's content (40 hex characters).
hash_value.title: Hash Value

include_scans.description: Also list the scans in which the file appeared.
include_scans.title: Include Scans

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

tools.name: search_js_fingerprint_by_sha256
tools.description: Look up a JavaScript file by SHA-256 across the archive and report its prevalence: total matches, unique scans, first and last seen, a prevalence label and the matching scripts; include_scans adds the scans, from_date and to_date limit the period. A rare hash shared by several phishing pages usually means one kit.

hash_value.description: SHA-256 of a JavaScript file's content (64 hex characters).
hash_value.title: Hash Value

include_scans.description: Also list the scans in which the file appeared.
include_scans.title: Include Scans

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

tools.name: find_js_fingerprint_similar_by_hash
tools.description: Find JavaScript files similar to the file with this content SHA-256, above threshold (default 0.7), up to limit results; exclude_exact_matches drops identical copies. Useful for finding modified versions of a known script.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of a JavaScript file's content (64 hex characters).
content_sha256.title: Content Sha256

exclude_exact_matches.description: Leave out files whose content is identical.
exclude_exact_matches.title: Exclude Exact Matches

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_bundler
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints built with a given bundler, each with scan, page URL and script URL.

bundler.description: Bundler, for example webpack, vite, rollup or esbuild.
bundler.title: Bundler

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_library
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints detected as a given library, each with scan, page URL, script URL and version.

library.description: Library name as detected, for example jquery, react or nextjs.
library.title: Library

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_library_version
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints detected as one library version, each with scan, page URL and script URL.

library.description: Library name as detected, for example jquery, react or nextjs.
library.title: Library

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_fuzzy_hash
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints whose fuzzy hash matches this value, each with scan, page URL and script URL. An empty list means no close match.

fuzzy_hash.description: Fuzzy hash of a JavaScript file, as shown in its fingerprint.
fuzzy_hash.title: Fuzzy Hash

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_md5
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints with this MD5, each with scan, page URL, scan time, script URL and hashes.

hash_value.description: MD5 of a JavaScript file's content (32 hex characters).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_normalized_hash
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints with this normalized hash (formatting-independent), each with scan, page URL and script URL.

hash_value.description: Normalized hash of a JavaScript file: its hash after whitespace and formatting are removed.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_sha1
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints with this SHA-1, each with scan, page URL, scan time, script URL and hashes.

hash_value.description: SHA-1 of a JavaScript file's content (40 hex characters).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.

tools.name: search_jsfingerprints_by_sha256
tools.description: Paginated list (limit and offset) of archived script fingerprints with this SHA-256, each with scan, page URL, scan time, script URL and hashes.

hash_value.description: SHA-256 of a JavaScript file's content (64 hex characters).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.

tools.name: get_jsfingerprint
tools.description: Get one JavaScript fingerprint record by its numeric fingerprint_id: the script URL, scan, hashes, metrics and ML vector information; include_functions and include_http_headers add more detail.

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

include_functions.description: Include the list of functions extracted from each script.
include_functions.title: Include Functions

include_http_headers.description: Include the HTTP response headers each script was served with.
include_http_headers.title: Include Http Headers

tools.name: get_jsfingerprint_similar
tools.description: Find JavaScript files whose fingerprint is similar to the one with this fingerprint_id, above threshold (0 to 1), paginated with limit and offset. exclude_same_scan drops matches from the same scan. Useful for finding variants of one script.

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

exclude_same_scan.description: Leave out files from the same scan.
exclude_same_scan.title: Exclude Same Scan

tools.name: get_jsfingerprint_similarity_counts
tools.description: Count how many archived JavaScript files are similar to the one with this fingerprint_id, per similarity model (composite, CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, AST and handcrafted features), capped at max_count. This query can take up to 90 seconds by default.

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

max_count.description: Stop counting at this number per model.
max_count.title: Max Count

tools.name: get_jsfingerprint_source
tools.description: Get the stored source code of one JavaScript file by its numeric fingerprint_id, with its SHA-256, URL and length. Source can be long.

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

tools.name: get_scan_deobfuscation
tools.description: List every script one scan captured, once per distinct content: whether and how it was obfuscated (tool and level), whether decoding or unpacking worked, and what became visible only after decoding (hosts, URLs, wallet addresses, threat-feed matches, messaging channels, WebAssembly). Each entry has the fingerprint_id of its full analysis. The level says how much effort went into hiding the code, not whether it is dangerous. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

tools.name: get_script_deobfuscation
tools.description: Get the deobfuscation analysis of one script: the obfuscation tool, techniques and level, what decoding and unpacking did, which decoded outputs exist, and what became visible only after decoding (URLs, hosts, wallet addresses, messaging channels). fingerprint_id is the numeric ID of a script fingerprint in a scan.

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

tools.name: get_script_decoded_source
tools.description: Get one decoded output of a script as text. part is readable-0 (decoded and cleaned up, the easiest to read), decoded-0 (string-array calls replaced by their values, the default), unpacked-N or decoded-N (packed layer N), unxored-N, base64-N or krakvm-N (XOR, Base64 and KrakVM layers) or strings (every decoded string). Not found when the script has no such output. Texts over 2 MiB are cut. The text is untrusted page code. fingerprint_id is the numeric ID of a script fingerprint in a scan.

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

part.description: Which decoded output: readable-0 (decoded and cleaned up), decoded-0 (the default), unpacked-N, decoded-N, unxored-N, base64-N, krakvm-N or strings.
part.title: Part

tools.name: get_script_command_literals
tools.description: Check one script for a Windows or macOS shell command held as a string literal, the ClickFix pattern in which a page puts a command on the clipboard and asks the visitor to run it, with any delivery-stealth signals. fingerprint_id is the numeric ID of a script fingerprint in a scan.

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

tools.name: get_file_analysis
tools.description: Get what reading one file delivered by a public scan found (a download, a file link, a command put on the clipboard, or a file inside one of those): type, size and hashes, verdict and its reasons, files inside it, Windows program details (signer, version information, compiler, build time, imports, debug file), capabilities with ATT&CK techniques, matching rules, antivirus detection names, embedded URLs and identifiers that tie it to other files. sha256 is the file's SHA-256 (64 hex characters).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file (64 hex characters).
sha256.title: Sha256

tools.name: get_jsfingerprint_bundle_stats
tools.description: Get statistics on bundled JavaScript across the archive for a date range: share of bundled files and the breakdown by bundler (webpack, vite, rollup and so on) and module format.

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

tools.name: get_jsfingerprint_library_stats
tools.description: Get statistics on JavaScript library detection across the archive for a date range: total fingerprints, detection rate and the most common libraries, each with its most common versions. limit (default 100) caps the libraries and versions_limit (default 10) the versions listed per library; total_libraries and each library's version_count give the full numbers.

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

min_count.description: Leave out libraries seen fewer times than this.
min_count.title: Min Count

versions_limit.description: Maximum number of versions listed per library, 0 to 1000 (default 10).
versions_limit.title: Versions Limit

tools.name: get_jsfingerprint_hash_prevalence
tools.description: For each script in one scan, report how common its hash is across the archive, which separates widely used library files from rare, page-specific code. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id
